title: Prediction Is Not a Sufficient Memory State
abstract: arXiv:2610.13881v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A memory that reproduces every current prediction may still have forgotten how to learn from the next observation. We characterize this distinction for exact cumulative learning and attention. For smooth convex residual losses with unrestricted real features and labels, a continuous recurrent state of fixed dimension exists exactly when the loss is polynomial. With ordinary, unweighted observations, degree $D$ requires precisely $r=\binom{d+D}{D}-1$ coordinates; even among histories with one fixed current predictor, exactly $r-d$ coordinates can remain necessary for continuation. Nonpolynomial losses have unbounded requirements on such equal-prediction histories. Bounded scalar logistic examples retain this obstruction after fixing any finite derivative jet. translated_title: 预测并不构成充分的记忆状态
translated_abstract: 一个能够复现所有当前预测的记忆，可能仍然已经忘记了如何从下一个观测中学习。我们针对精确累积学习刻画了这一区别。对于具有无约束实值特征与标签的光滑凸残差损失，固定维度的连续循环状态当且仅当损失为多项式时才存在。对于普通的未加权观测，$D$ 次多项式损失恰好需要 $r=\binom{d+D}{D}-1$ 个坐标；即使在具有同一固定当前预测器的历史之中，继续学习仍可能恰好需要 $r-d$ 个坐标。非多项式损失在这类“相同预测”的历史上具有无界的状态需求。有界标量逻辑斯蒂（logistic）的例子在固定任意有限阶导数喷后仍保留这一障碍。对于岭回归，隐藏的证据就是设计矩阵：精确状态需要 $dp+d(d+1)/2$ 的代价，而预测器仅需 $dp$。在一个良态的零预测族上，最优化……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明仅能复现当前预测的记忆状态不足以支持后续学习：在精确累积学习中，固定维度的循环状态仅当损失为多项式时存在，且即使在当前预测完全相同的历史之间，继续学习仍可能额外需要 $r-d$ 个状态坐标（例如岭回归中必须存储设计矩阵）。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that a memory reproducing every current prediction is not a sufficient memory state for continued learning: for exact cumulative learning, a fixed-dimension recurrent state exists only for polynomial losses, and even prediction-equivalent histories can require up to $r-d$ additional state coordinates (e.g., storing the design matrix in ridge regression).
